question: Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word. Exonerate
solution:
The correct answer is: **Convict**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Exonerate"** means to clear someone from blame or responsibility, particularly after being accused of wrongdoing. (दोषमुक्त करना)
 
 
• **Example:** The court exonerated him after reviewing the evidence, proving he was innocent.
 
 
 
 
• **"Convict"** refers to declaring someone guilty of a crime or wrongdoing, typically after a trial. (दोषी ठहराना)
 
 
• **Example:** After a lengthy trial, the jury decided to convict him of fraud charges.
 
 
 
 
• Since the antonym of "Exonerate" is "Convict," as it directly opposes the meaning of clearing someone from blame, this is the correct answer.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Convict**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Free** (मुक्त): To release someone from captivity or control.
 
 
• **Example:** The prisoner was set free after serving his sentence.
 
 
 
 
• **Excuse** (माफ करना): To forgive someone or to provide a reason for something wrong.
 
 
• **Example:** Please excuse my tardiness; the traffic was terrible.
 
 
 
 
• **Liberate** (मुक्त करना): To set someone free from oppression or confinement.
 
 
• **Example:** The army liberated the town from enemy forces.
